These pages were written by course participants, researchers in fisheries,
oceanography, ecology and related fields, using data from their own work. They are
not tidy teaching examples. They show the methods from the course meeting real data,
with the compromises that involves.

Each page states where its data came from and whether it can be shared. Where the
underlying data is embargoed or licensed, the page says so and uses a stand-in
dataset for the figures.

::: {.callout-note}
Contributing a page? See `.claude/contributed-pages.md` in the repository for the
front matter, data-permission checks and review flow. Start from
`contributed/_template.qmd`.
:::
